name: Seowon, Korean Neo-Confucian Academies
description: These are nine historic Neo-Confucian academies spread across central and southern South Korea, built during the Joseon dynasty. Each combined a school with a shrine honouring a revered scholar. They sit beside mountains and streams, and open-sided pavilions let students study while looking out over the landscape. Together they show how Chinese philosophy took on a distinctly Korean form.
